name: shelled-box
why: 17112 mm3 is a hollow box; roughly 21600 is the shrunken solid that hollow() used to return. The volume is what tells those two apart. The perception block holds the shell's wall itself: a ray along X at the origin enters the outer wall at -32, leaves it at -30, re-enters at 30 and leaves at 32, so the first run of material is the 2 mm wall and 4 mm in all, and the thickness sweep's minimum is that wall, 2.000, exact on the flat faces.
